lines.text: Parents should save up for their children, and I will gladly spend my money and my house for your souls.
I urged Timothy to visit you, and I asked whether he exploited you.

problems.problem: Its true detail "parents should save up for their children" isn't in 2 Corinthians 12:14 word for word.
Its wrong detail "Children should save up for their parents" is 7 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
